skills.reviewNote: Simplified roguelike area presentation: original marker, rotated blue beam and alpha screen fade; total 3x physical damage once at F165 without extra recoil. Source ten 10-percent hits F125..215 remain provenance and are intentionally combined. Unknown raw member offsets 150/-150 and fade offset 150 stay unapplied. No original-game fidelity claim. The original alpha fade is fitted to the arena using measured sheet content bounds; no replacement rectangle is drawn. Clockwise 45-degree artwork correction around each target origin makes the source diagonal beam horizontal; source XYZ rotation is retained separately.
